glosses: English or American mile (a unit of distance equivalent to about 1.6 km)
milla, Spanish mile (a traditional unit of distance equivalent to 1,000 pasos, about 1.4 km)

examples.en: I run five miles a day.
I walk twenty miles a day.

examples.text: Mi casa está a solo una milla de aquí.
examples.en: My house is only a mile from here.
